title: Kafka message envelope
description: Every apparule.* message on the CueLABS shared bus (decisions.md X-11). Every product can read the lanes, so producers always write the payload to Apparule's storage prefix and send `data_ref` (system-design.md §5.3). `data` stays valid for tests and fixtures; exactly one of the two is set.

type.description: The event name, which is also the name of the schema `data` must match.

id.description: Message id; consumers deduplicate on it.
